# Assets · Logos

3 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for gradnext-wordmark-rhino.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The gradnext wordmark as vector SVG, traced from the guideline artwork (587×156 viewBox, single ink each).

- `gradnext-wordmark-rhino.svg` — ink #2E3558 (`rhino`). Default on white and light grey.
- `gradnext-wordmark-white.svg` — ink #FFFFFF. On rhino, rhino-950, midnight and dark gradients.
- `gradnext-wordmark-midnight.svg` — ink #0D1028 (`midnight`). The small header mark on white pages.
